claims.evidence: File names Mel888_* and Hutu80_*; paper names Mel888 (melanoma) and Hutu80 (small intestine adenocarcinoma); Cellosaurus search returns these identifiers.
Cellosaurus donor age/sex, not stated in the PRIDE record or paper.
Paper: Hutu80 is a small intestine adenocarcinoma line; no site given for Mel888.

claims.value: MHC class I protein complex; HLA-A*02:01,HLA-A*24:02
claims.evidence: Paper: peptides eluted from HLA-A*02:01 / HLA-A*24:02; Mel888 A24 + A2 and Hutu80 A2 + A24 (each line has one natural and one transduced allele).
Pulldown of HLA-bound peptides described as 'previously described'; paper reports bead-based pulldown with acid elution (1% TFA) for the related method. Closest allowed value.
Paper: n = 3 independent experiments, one technical replicate each; files PRM1-3 per line. Mapping of file number to experiment number assumed.
RAW header of Mel888_PRM1.raw reads 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS' and 'Method of Q Exactive HF'; PRIDE field agrees; protocol/paper say 'Q Exactive'.
PRIDE sample protocol and paper (PRM method).
RAW header method XML: Fragmentation_HCD / NCE 27; protocol text NCE 27.
No chemical labelling; heavy-isotope synthetic peptides were spiked as standards.
Native HLA-eluted peptides, no protease digestion.
Searchresults.xlsx is a dummy sheet; PRM analysed in Skyline, no database search.
Two cell lines quantified for CTNNB1-S37F neopeptide levels.

limitations: Deposited PXD054276_community_annotated.sdrf.tsv was deliberately not consulted (independent annotation).
Cellosaurus age/sex used for the cell lines; not disclosed in the PRIDE record or paper.

Fully-specified HLA genotype per line is from the paper text (natural plus transduced allele); other HLA class I alleles of the lines are not listed, so mhc typing is partial; mhc typing method not recorded.
Enrichment method wording is the nearest allowed value; the PRM pulldown protocol is only cited ('as previously described'), and antibody not stated, so antibody enrichment = not available.
Heavy isotope-labelled spike-in peptides (20 ng each of four peptides) are not encoded in characteristics[spiked compound]; the multi-peptide structured syntax was not attempted.
Replicate numbering (PRM1-3 = independent experiments 1-3) is an inference from file names plus 'n = 3'; culture medium and passage not available.
No modification, tolerance or enzyme settings exist (no search); set to not available / not applicable.
'HuTu 80' (Cellosaurus recommended name) is flagged by tools check because ontology labels read 'HuTu 80 cell' (CLO) / 'HuTu-80 cell' (BTO); kept deliberately.
Cell-line modification (HLA transduction) not encoded as separate column; Mel888 cells are labelled by parental line.
